# Sales operations skill

Reuse `growth/core/crm.mjs` and the future module #70. Create safe pipeline fixtures (new, qualified, contacted, proposal, won, lost) and explicitly record legal basis/evidence when relevant. Respect recipient opposition, tenant isolation, deletion requests, data minimization and retention.

Write proposals and campaign **drafts** only. Do not search for private addresses, scrape personal data, send email/DM/SMS, or automate outreach. Genuine campaigns require separately verified legitimacy, records, limits, infrastructure and authorization.
